scripture.verse: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the Lord's.

And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven. But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

But we are bound to give thanks always to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

sermons.title: Sermon 43 | The Death of the Christian

scripture.verse: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth; and one convert him; Let him know that he which converteth sinner from the error of his way, shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
Lord thou hast been our dwelling-place in all generations.

sermons.title: Sermon 47 | Christ's Prayer for His People

scripture.verse: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him.
